_note: Did a damaging flood or cloudburst actually hit this village in the scenario window? Only facts from public reporting fetched and read on 2026-10-11. 'uncertain' means we could not find a village-specific report either way; those villages are left out of every score. No village is marked 'no_event': we could not verify an absence, so false alarms cannot be counted yet. event_day is the first damaging day (UTC date).

thunag.what: Video of a flash flood in the Thunag area was reported in July 2023, but we could not confirm the date falls inside 7-11 July or that the village itself was damaged.
